name: opening
note: A new game starts in the cinematic scene Opening_Sequence (GameManager.StartNewGame), then Tut_01, where Hornet lies down at 1 mask until the player binds (ListenForCast). The Opening_Sequence part is the host's own: a cinematic scene, where no friend can be (SSMP's SceneUtil); the probe plays the Tut_01 part.

name: weakness_scene
note: The opening's weak walk: a trigger (Trigger2dEvent) takes control through a sub-FSM (RunFSM), the player walks the weak hero (ListenForRight and the other inputs), and a faint_fader blacks the screen as she faints, then she gets up (Resume: RegainControl).

name: churchkeeper_intro
note: Bone Bottom's first entry: a trigger (WOUND) has the Churchkeeper hail Hornet, who collapses (Bonetown's Weakness Scene, its PD Bool churchKeeperIntro), wakes and talks; Set End sets churchKeeperIntro, completedTutorial and defeatedMossMother.

name: bellhart_arrival
note: Runs as the room loads: control taken at Init, a video (TriggerStartVideo), the camera up and down (StartFreeCameraMode, iTweenMoveTo), the area title, control back.

name: bellhart_web
note: Hornet wakes stuck in a web (Init tests spinnerDefeated and CheckIsFirstLevelForPlayer), struggles (ListenForAttack and the other inputs), breaks free and lands. Not followed: a wake-up on a continue or a join into Belltown (about 4 in 10, its Init's random cancel), each player's own; followed it would pull every player in Belltown into the web whenever one joined there.

name: greymoor_crash
note: A trigger (Trigger2dEvent) takes control and sends the hero through the floor to Greymoor_01.

name: judge_gate
note: Act 1's end: after the Last Judge, walking to the gate (CheckTrackTriggerCount) plays the gate's video (StartCinematic) and moves the hero to the Citadel (Coral_10, left_firstEntrance).

name: mr_mushroom
note: Each find of the Mr Mushroom quest (begun at Aqueduct_05's tablet): a talk, then he flies off in a rocket with the hero's control taken.

name: lace_intro
note: Her talk before her first fight takes control until its dialogue ends (End Dialogue 2).

name: widow_intro
object: Black Thread States Thread Only Variant/Normal World/Boss Scene/Speak Region
note: Her room waits in Speak Ready for a talk at her Speak Region; its Dialogue ends in End, which shuts the talk place and sends SPOKEN: her room sends her out (Spinner Tele Out) and starts the battle (BATTLE START). Followed from End, so the scene host's game, which runs her, starts her fight whoever talked; the talk leaves the hero held until her roar, run only there, so the other games give theirs back at her start (bosses.json's release).

name: phantom_parry
note: Her end: the parried hit (FINAL BLOCK), then a clash with the hero placed and control taken (Hornet Position, Final Parry) that gives the parry.

name: silk_heart_bellbeast
note: After the Bell Beast its Silk Heart bobs where it fell; touching it (Trigger2dEvent) loads Memory_Silk_Heart_BellBeast, and Silk Heart Memory Return brings the hero back.

name: silk_heart_songgolem
note: The same after the Fourth Chorus, to Memory_Silk_Heart_SongGolem.

name: crest_beast
note: A bind at the crest's rune (ListenForCast) takes control and loads its memory scene (Memory_Beast), which gives the crest.

name: drifters_cloak
note: The Seamstress's talk ends in a video and the cloak (hasBrolly).

name: charge_slash
object: Pinstress States/Ground Sitting/Pinstress Interior Ground Sit
note: The Pinstress's lesson: a video and the needle strike (hasChargeSlash).

name: needolin_memory
note: The Needolin played in its region (CheckHeroPerformanceRegion) takes control and moves the camera into a memory and back. Also as thread_memory vassal (Aqueduct_05, Aspid_01, Bone_East_14, Shellwood_26) and thread_memory_tank (Organ_01).

name: bellway_ride
note: The bell rung, the Bell Beast comes, the rider picks a station and travels through the cinematic scene Cinematic_Stag_travel; at the station Hero Fling Out drops the hero.

name: caravan_ride
note: The flea caravan moves on with the hero inside (Room_Caravan_Interior_Travel).

name: farsight
note: A video in Hornet's Bellhart room; what starts it is unknown from the dump (no trigger in its FSM).
